title: Will you be one of the people to take the initiative to bring people ...
description: Will you be one of the people to take the initiative to bring people together in your neighborhood? Hi, I'm Laura, a green living & money coach, with a very different perspective on what constitutes true wealth in the midst of late stage capitalism & climate change.  To my mind one of the most valuable forms of capital we can build to ensure our resilience on this climate challenged planet is SOCIAL CAPITAL (community, cooperation, our connections to others). That's the form of capital that has gotten our ancestors through all of the earlier droughts, floods, famines, wars, and other disasters throughout human history on this planet. And that's what we're going to need to rely on as well. The easiest and best place to start building community is often right outside your front door and as my friend Sara has shown us, it doesn't take a lot to start making it happen.  But financial capital and social capital are just a couple of the forms of capital and wealth that we can tap to develop a more holistic wealth portfolio for ourselves. There's also spiritual capital, living or natural capital, experiential capital, and several others. These are the forms of capital that add meaning, joy, and a heck of a lot more resilience to our lives in the face of climate change. 🌍Check out the 🔗 in my bio to grab a sample excerpt of my book Growing FREE to learn more about building true wealth on our climate challenged planet. #buildingcommunity #neighbors #anticapitalist #greenliving #tiktokban
